notes: For the owner: SPEC 4.0 says every preset is a state object and a link, while 6.6 keeps the tab of T11 out of a link. A link to T11's preset 'average' (M6 b10) therefore opens the Fold tab. P4-A4 recorded this and MERGE accepted it at P4 wave 4.2. This lens confirmed that every other field of the preset round-trips.

For RT-07: T10.spec.ts 'no long task after a ring click on the largest main-thread configuration' failed 3 of 4 runs at load average 2.7, on a build that differed only in the drawPicture turning flag, which B6 node 4 (1920 edges) never reaches. It passed 5 of 5 on the clean build at load 2.0, and 2 of 2 on the same mutated build afterwards, so it is timing noise. The test is sensitive to machine load.

T10 computes its Coxeter-plane ring sizes and distinct dots from its own projected points (P = E C^-1 in t10/scene.ts, projector.ts ringsOf and countDistinct), not from the engine's coxeterPlaneRings, which covers roots only. This is display statistics on an arbitrary orbit, which no engine function provides, so it is not reported against SPEC 7.3. Mutating coxeterPlaneRings would not change the tool's output.

ci.yml carries the comment 'The lab timings join in phase 3 (P3-A7)', but the workflow has no npm run lab step. SPEC 7.7 asks for lab timings at gates G3, G4 and G6 only, so this is a stale comment, not a missing step.
